meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 它会在成功的编辑类操作（如 apply_patch、write、edit 等）后自动做注释检查：一旦 comment-checker 报警，Codex 会收到阻断性反馈，需要先修复或解释被标记的注释，再继续往下做。
howto.when: 当 Codex 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类调用后触发；非编辑类工具不受影响，缺少检查器程序时不产生任何钩子输出。

say.text: 这条注释警告是什么意思？

say.note: 修改注释后再继续任务

say.text: 这条警告可以忽略吗？说明原因
say.note: 不改的话需要给出解释

howto.what_en: After a successful edit-like call (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.), a PostToolUse hook runs comment checking. If comment-checker warns, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers after Codex makes a successful apply_patch, write, edit or similar edit call; non-edit tools are ignored, and a missing checker binary produces no hook output.

say_en.text: What does this comment warning mean?

say_en.note: Comments get fixed before work continues

say_en.text: Can I ignore this warning? Explain why
say_en.note: You get a reason if no fix is made
